objective: Add an explicit owner-triggered Vietnamese OCR path to the existing M08 snapshot flow using pinned RapidOCR 3.9.1 with PP-OCRv6 small detection and recognition models on the shared Torch CUDA runtime, while retaining only bounded untrusted text inside the existing maximum-15-second observation.
non_goals: Do not capture continuously, bypass the browser display picker, or enable perception by default.
Do not persist screenshot pixels, PNG bytes, OCR crops, recognized text, or OCR prompts outside the in-memory TTL observation.
Do not fall back to CPU, ONNX Runtime CPU, DirectML, PaddlePaddle, a remote OCR API, or a second OCR model when CUDA is unavailable.
Do not feed OCR output into memory, chat context, tools, game controls, or autonomous decisions in this slice.
Do not complete M08 or start event-driven capture, OS window allowlists, privacy masks, or the full 200-case replay gate in this slice.
Do not claim Vietnamese OCR quality promotion when the recorded UI CER gate is not met; expose the measured limitation to the owner instead.
contracts: OCR runs only when the owner explicitly sets the OCR option on an already-authorized perception.observe snapshot request.
The provider is fixed to RapidOCR 3.9.1, PP-OCRv6 small detection and recognition, Torch CUDA device 0, batch one request at a time, and fails closed when CUDA is unavailable; no CPU fallback exists.
The shared local resource scheduler grants a bounded preemptible OCR lease and preserves at least 2048 MiB live VRAM headroom.
OCR text, confidence, and normalized boxes are bounded, marked trustLevel=untrusted and decisionSupportEligible=false, and expire with the parent observation after at most 15 seconds.
PNG bytes are passed to OCR only in memory and discarded after inference; no raw pixel, crop, model input, or OCR output is written to disk or logs.
An OCR failure produces a stable visible E_PERCEPTION_OCR state while preserving the base evidence and any separately requested VLM result.
allowed_dependencies: RapidOCR transitive packages already resolved by uv, including OpenCV, Pillow, NumPy, Shapely and PyYAML
PP-OCRv6 small Torch detection and recognition weights with exact SHA-256 values from the RapidOCR 3.9.1 manifest
acceptance_criteria: Perception unit tests prove explicit opt-in, no implicit OCR call, bounded/sanitized untrusted output, normalized boxes, provider error preservation, close/unload, and absence of pixel/base64 data in observations.
Control-plane route tests prove the X-Hina-OCR-Analyze header reaches the provider and the default route remains OCR-free.
The Quan sát dashboard has a plain-language GPU OCR option, shows recognized text/confidence/error, and explains when to use OCR instead of the heavier VLM.

A real owner-GPU smoke confirms Torch CUDA execution, reports measured VRAM and Vietnamese UI CER, and leaves at least 2048 MiB free headroom. A CER above 5 percent must be reported as qualityGatePassed=false and remains blocked from quality promotion.
Focused perception tests, core route tests, JavaScript syntax validation, and Dev Console startup smoke pass once.
